observations: Multiple large solar panels stacked vertically in a warehouse or shop setting.
The panels feature monocrystalline cells with a half-cut cell design (visible horizontal dividing line).
Cardboard corner protectors are visible on several panels.
A watermark 'OKWYTEX ENTERPRISES' and 'POSTED ON Jiji' is overlaid on the image.
No technical specification labels, brand logos, or model numbers are visible on the front of the panels.

claims.evidence: Quality cannot be determined from a distance without testing or verifying the supply chain.

risks.proof: A clear photo of the technical specification label (nameplate) on the back of a panel.
risks.if_unproven: as a low-capacity panel (e.g., 250W) despite the large physical size.

risks.proof: A photo of the brand logo or the manufacturer details on the back label.
An electroluminescence (EL) test report or a video showing stable voltage/current output in sunlight.

proof_requests: Photo of the technical specification label on the back of the panel showing wattage, voltage, and brand.
Close-up photo of any brand logo on the front or frame.
Video showing a multimeter test of the open-circuit voltage (Voc) in daylight.
response.reason: The wattage and brand are the primary drivers of value for solar panels and are completely missing from the photos. Without the technical label from the back, it is impossible to distinguish between a 350W and a 550W panel.
